source_name: MBH Bank Nyrt. – Éves jelentés és közgyűlési előterjesztések
why_relevant: Hungary's second-largest bank, formed by the Budapest Bank / MKB / Takarékbank merger — its annual reports and AGM packs are the auditable record of post-merger headcount reduction and board reconstitution, exactly the organizational-change signal this cell must anchor.

source_name: Budapesti Értéktőzsde (BÉT) – kibocsátói közzétételek / newkibdata document store
why_relevant: Parallel mandatory publication venue for HU listed banks; its newkibdata file store hosts the actual annual-report and AGM PDFs (e.g. OTP integrated annual report, MBH quarterly reports, Gránit company page), making it a stable secondary retrieval path when issuer sites move files.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine – CDX Server API (leadership-page diffing)
why_relevant: The core ARCHIVE/AUDIT instrument for this cell: the CDX index returns every capture of a bank's 'vezetőség'/'management'/'rólunk' page with timestamp, status and content digest. Digest changes pinpoint when a name silently disappeared from a leadership page — detecting departures that were never announced.

source_name: Gránit Bank Nyrt. – éves jelentés (issuer PDF, also mirrored by MBH Befektetési Bank)
why_relevant: Fast-growing HU digital bank, newly listed; its annual report carries board composition and headcount, and growth-phase hiring shows up as headcount step-changes in the filed accounts. Also demonstrates that third-party investment-bank sites mirror issuer annual reports — a useful redundancy path.

source_name: UniCredit Bank Hungary – Éves és gyorsjelentések (jelzálogbank)
why_relevant: Example of the foreign-owned-subsidiary pattern: HU subsidiaries of international groups are not BÉT-listed for equity but still publish éves jelentés (often via a mortgage-bank issuer entity) containing board rosters and headcount. Establishes the retrieval pattern to replicate for K&H, Erste, Raiffeisen, CIB, Erste Jelzálogbank etc.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Jelentések (Hungarian Banking Association reports)
why_relevant: Association reports and member listing act as an authoritative actor map for the HU banking sector (which entities exist, their legal names) and periodically summarise sector employment and branch-network changes — a pointer layer that keeps the filings watchlist complete.

source_name: Nemzeti Cégtár (BCE Nemzeti Cégtár Nonprofit Zrt.)
why_relevant: Free searchable interface over the ~600k registered Hungarian companies with basic data plus supplementary information; convenient for resolving legal names, tax numbers and cégjegyzékszám for banks, PSPs and fintech subsidiaries before hitting the official registers.

source_name: MNB – Hitelintézetek adatszolgáltatás (supervisory reporting hub)
why_relevant: Defines what credit institutions must report to the supervisor and on what schedule; identifies which supervisory tables carry staff/branch-count fields and therefore which published aggregates can be back-mapped to individual institutions. A methodological pointer for building the headcount time series.

source_name: MNB Piacfelügyelet és kibocsátói felügyelet
why_relevant: Explains issuer disclosure obligations and the triple-publication rule (own site + BÉT + kozzetetelek.mnb.hu), which is the rule that guarantees a redundant, archivable copy of every leadership-change disclosure for listed HU banks. Essential for designing a complete, non-missable collection route.

source_name: HIPA – Hungarian Investment Promotion Agency (news/press room, HU + EN)
source_subtype: government investment promotion agency press room
why_relevant: HIPA is the state body that co-announces every subsidised business service centre (SSC/GBS) investment, including those of foreign banks and asset managers, with explicit headcount figures (e.g. Janus Henderson 400 jobs in Budapest, BMW BSC 50 jobs in Debrecen). Announcements typically precede actual hiring by 6-18 months, making it the earliest hard signal of planned bank back-office headcount growth in Hungary.

source_name: HOA – Hungarian Service and Outsourcing Association (Magyar Szolgáltatóipari és Outsourcing Szövetség)
why_relevant: Sector association of Hungarian SSC/GBS operators (200+ centres, ~74k employees) that has published an annual sector/benchmark report since 2013 including headcount growth intentions, salary and attrition benchmarks, and a member list — an actor map of every foreign bank running a Budapest back office. Best single pointer source for the cell.

source_name: European Business Services Association – news
why_relevant: Aggregates CEE GBS/SSC expansion and hiring announcements including Budapest finance/banking centres (Janus Henderson 400 hires, Sanofi +500, BMW Debrecen). Useful English cross-check and de-duplication layer for HIPA announcements, and covers moves not picked up by Hungarian national press.

source_name: Budapest Business Journal (BBJ) – business services / people & appointments coverage
why_relevant: English-language Hungarian business paper with a dedicated business-services beat and an appointments/'people' section; reports HOA survey findings on headcount growth plans and SSC leadership changes that the Hungarian financial press ignores.

source_name: haon.hu – Hajdú-Bihar county daily, 'helyi gazdasag' (local economy) section
why_relevant: Primary county news outlet for Debrecen; covers investment announcements made jointly by the municipality, University of Debrecen and the foreign ministry (e.g. BMW business service centre, 50 jobs; Prohuman staffing centre opening) — local-only announcements that never reach national financial press.

source_name: hajdupress.hu – Debrecen/Hajdú-Bihar regional news
why_relevant: Second Debrecen outlet that independently covered the BMW business service centre announcement; useful redundancy when haon paywalls an item and for local council/HIPA joint events.

source_name: EDC Debrecen (Debrecen Economic Development Centre) – gazdaságfejlesztés
why_relevant: The municipal investment-promotion arm that negotiates and announces incoming service-centre investments in Debrecen; publishes site/labour offers and news on new employers ahead of national coverage. Direct counterpart of HIPA at city level for the Debrecen leg of the cell.

source_name: Debrecen 2030 economic development / job creation programme portal
why_relevant: City strategy portal framing planned job-creation and regional cooperation; useful for forward-looking context on which service sectors Debrecen is actively courting (including back-office/finance) rather than for individual hiring events.

source_name: Szeged Megyei Jogú Város Önkormányzata – 'befektető' tag / investor news
why_relevant: Municipal channel for investor and job-creation announcements in Szeged, the third city named in the cell. Note the URL found is the legacy ('regi') site, indicating a migration — the current portal must be located during verification.

source_name: Szeged Ma (szegedma.hu) – Szeged/Csongrád-Csanád local news
why_relevant: Local outlet covering Szeged employer and University of Szeged news; the natural place a bank back-office or fintech centre opening in Szeged would first be reported. No bank-specific hit surfaced in this run, so track as a monitoring channel rather than a proven producer.

source_name: Delmagyar.hu – Csongrád-Csanád county daily
why_relevant: County daily for Szeged and surroundings, part of the same regional publishing group as haon; local economy section is the counterpart channel for southern-Hungary employer expansion news.

source_name: Budapesti Corvinus Egyetem – university news / partnership announcements
why_relevant: Corvinus signs multi-year strategic partnerships with banks (e.g. three-year MBH Bank partnership routing students into the bank's internship and 'Start+' graduate programme) and with professional-services firms. Such agreements are the earliest weak signal of planned graduate intake volumes and of which business lines a bank is staffing up.

source_name: Corvinus Tehetségprogram regulation (BCE rule repository on net.jogtar.hu)
why_relevant: The formal internal regulation of Corvinus' talent programme; documents structure, corporate-partner modules and diploma-supplement recognition. Provides the vocabulary and programme architecture needed to interpret bank–university partnership announcements correctly.

source_name: BME (Budapest University of Technology and Economics) – news & faculty news (VIK)
why_relevant: BME announces strategic agreements with banks (OTP Bank cybersecurity education/research partnership; MNB cooperation programme with scholarships and TDK mentoring). Bank–engineering-university tie-ups indicate where banks intend to build IT/cyber/data headcount, typically 1-2 years before job postings appear.

source_name: MNB–BME cooperation programme portal
why_relevant: Dedicated portal for the central bank's flagship university partnership (scholarships, research chairs, competitions). MNB talent pipelines feed both the regulator and the commercial banking sector; the programme also names the finance/digitalisation topics the central bank is prioritising.

source_name: MNB – Network of Higher Education Cooperations (felsőoktatási együttműködések hálózata)
why_relevant: Central-bank-maintained register of its university partnerships across Hungary — an off-the-shelf actor map linking finance-sector institutions to specific universities and faculties, including regional ones (Debrecen, Szeged) relevant to this cell.

source_name: BME Állásbörze (Műegyetemi Állásbörze) – exhibitor list
why_relevant: Hungary's largest and oldest university job fair (100+ exhibitors, twice yearly). The exhibitor roster is a cheap, dated proxy for which banks and bank service centres are actively recruiting graduates in a given semester; year-on-year presence/absence is a headcount-intent signal.

source_name: OTP Bank career portal – Gyakornoki program (internship programme)
why_relevant: Live listing of OTP's trainee vacancies including OTP LAB innovation-centre roles in AI/automation. Volume and functional mix of trainee openings is a leading indicator of where the group plans to grow; it also names internal units (OTP LAB) that reveal organisational structure.

source_name: MFB (Magyar Fejlesztési Bank) career portal – Gyakornoki program
why_relevant: State development bank's traineeship page; state-owned bank graduate intake is a distinct pipeline and its cadence tracks public-sector financial institution restructuring.
